youtube_description: Find out how Mercury’s square and Venus’s trine will reshape Pisces love life and career this week. Discover the exact planetary shifts that could boost your romance and wallet, plus a powerful career restructuring. Comment your sign for a personalized reading!
script_text: The coming week is a turbulent tide for you Pisceans, as hidden currents finally surface. Monday's Mercury square Neptune in your 12th house stirs doubts, draining energy. Wednesday's Venus trine Jupiter in your 7th house amplifies romance, encouraging bold new connections. Friday's oppositional Sun in your 10th house opposes Pluto in your 4th, forcing a decisive career restructuring. Thursday's Mercury sextile Saturn in your 2nd house grounds finances, turning spending into saving, while Friday's Venus conjunct your natal Neptune in the 5th house deepens artistic inspiration and reward. The weekend's relaxed Pisces Moon in your 1st house offers soothing reflection and gentle emotional renewal. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House. Monday is your worst day because Mercury square Neptune clouds communication. Channel Neptune's intuition by journaling each morning to clarify decisions and stay ahead of challenges. Follow for daily updates.
